chunks: Muhammad ibn 'Ali ibn Mahbub, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn 'Isa, from al-Husayn, from Fadalah, from Hisham ibn Hudhayl, from Abi al-Hasan al-Madi عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about the time of salat al-fajr, and he said: when the dawn spreads across the horizon, so that you see it like the river of Sura'.

key_terms.الْفَجْرُ: the dawn light marking the start of the fajr prayer time
key_terms.صَلَاةِ الْفَجْرِ: the dawn prayer performed at the time of true dawn
key_terms.نَهَرِ سُورَاءَ: a simile indicating a broad, extended visible appearance
key_terms.وَقْتِ: the appointed time or prescribed beginning of an act of worship

ai.seo_question: When does the time of salat al-fajr begin according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal indication for the time of salat al-fajr. It describes the beginning of the prayer time as the moment when the true dawn stretches across the horizon and becomes visibly widespread.
